title: keel ACK
description: The ACK a seat returns before its first counted edit, on its runtime's submit channel (final message, MCP keel_submit or outbox). The Steward validates it at ingest: the id set must equal the brief's, write_set must be a subset and brief_hash must match. A second mismatch sets blocked(ack_mismatch).
$comment: Authored in the OpenAI strict subset (every property required, additionalProperties false, null unions instead of optional fields); scripts/validate.mjs lints it. Before passing it to a runtime flag the dispatcher bundles the $refs and strips $schema, $id, $comment, title and x-keel-* annotations.

brief_hash.description: Echo of the brief id from the brief header.

ids.description: The per-seat id set; it must equal the brief's ack_id_set.ids.

write_set.description: Paths the seat plans to write; a subset of the brief's write_set, empty for seats that write nothing.

questions.description: Questions to raise before work; each becomes an ask routed by clause.

question.description: A question routed by clause type: requirements to product, architecture and obligations to the architect, plan steps and interfaces to the planner, and ACC, scope, non-goals, INV and goals to the Board.

clause.description: Id of the clause the question is about: an R, ACC, INV or obligation id, a plan step or an interface name.
